hook: 8 clear bins for $29.99 emptied my garage floor

scenes.visual_prompt: Floor covered in mismatched cardboard boxes, some soft and sagging from humidity
scenes.on_screen_text: Cardboard boxes, gone soft from humidity
scenes.voiceover: My old bins were basically falling apart.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a torn box handle ripping as someone tries to lift it
scenes.voiceover: Sagging, molding, lids that never actually sealed.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing an 8-pack of clear heavy-duty storage bins with reinforced handles, lining them up
scenes.voiceover: 8 bins, reinforced handles, 4.8 stars across 3,672 reviews.

scenes.visual_prompt: Stacking the clear bins onto a floating shelf, contents like holiday lights and tools visible through the lids
scenes.on_screen_text: See through the lid, skip the search
scenes.voiceover: I find holiday lights in 5 minutes now, not 30.

scenes.visual_prompt: Lifting a fully packed bin by its handle to demonstrate it holding weight without tearing
scenes.voiceover: Books, tools, decor — no tearing, no cracking.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of the organized shelf full of matching bins, empty floor beneath it
Text card with the full garage wall system in the background, softly blurred
scenes.on_screen_text: Full $91 garage system on the blog.
scenes.voiceover: Link in bio for the rest of the build.

caption: The 8-pack of clear bins that got every box off my garage floor for $29.99 — 4.8 stars across 3,672 reviews, and after using them I get why. Full breakdown on the blog.
